01 / SIMULATE

Choose a scenario and press Play. Pause or step through it to inspect the entry, checkpoint and outcome.

A honeypot is a deliberately placed decoy service. Synthetic data attracts suspicious access so the session can be observed and isolated.

How it works & limitations

The original report §V lists honeypots as an optional recommendation. The detection, alert and session-isolation sequence here is a modern teaching extension. It assumes this particular attempt reaches an isolated decoy.

Requires segmentation and least privilege in the improved plan and a supported scenario. Only the suspicious session is revoked; normal users keep their permissions. No real customer data is placed in the decoy. It does not guarantee that an attacker will target it or remain trapped.

Honeypot cost and effectiveness are excluded from budget and risk scoring. It is not a universal defense against DDoS or guest Wi-Fi interception. Already affected endpoints still require recovery.

Concept references: NIST honeypot definition and NIST SP 800-53, SC-26 Decoys.

    RECOMMENDED WITHIN BUDGET

    ILLUSTRATIVE RISK INDEX

    Cost units are illustrative, not vendor quotes. The risk index is not an attack probability or a measured financial loss.

    03 / UNDERSTAND THE MODEL

    Transparent assumptions. Inspectable results.

    Scenario baseline weights are 25 / 20 / 20 / 20 / 15. Each residual term equals its weight multiplied by (1 − assumed effectiveness) for every effective control. Their sum is the risk index. Segmentation and secure communications depend on the improved architecture; guest isolation and permissions also affect the relevant terms.

    The recommendation checks all 128 combinations of seven controls and selects the lowest illustrative residual index within budget. RBAC uses a permission-density heuristic. The source report does not provide calibrated effectiveness values, prices or measured hotel telemetry.

    Data access uses one fixed HR-to-payment-records request. Control independence, regional impact and recovery are simplified. These results support explanation and comparison, not procurement, compliance certification or operational security guarantees.

    Who can access what?
